reviews.title: The photo analysis function always has negative feedback
reviews.text:
Update on 9/10/26: I just tried this app again after many months and many updates and they have changed and fixed nothing. The AI feature never gets the food right and you can't tell it what's in the picture. The whole point of logging food and journaling food is so you can go back and see what you ate that day or see patterns in your food so the log not being right is an issue. Yes, I understand you can add a note but the rest of the log is wrong and you can't change anything other than your note. The suggestions on what to change in the future are questionable at best because, again the food they think you're eating is wrong and the app is not worth the $10 a month minimum just to use it!!! Gave it a second chance and it's still the same awful app. The image-to-log feature is what most people are paying for and it sucks so I shouldn't be paying for a feature I can't use! 

2/24/25: The app is fine until you use the photo analysis feature. It will always tell you it's not good. The first few times I didnt care beacsue my meals were not as good as it could have been but even if you do the suggestions it says and you replace everything with the “better option” it still says its processed even if you made it from scratch or its high in sodium even if you used all low sodium or it not enough veggies or its high in sugar when there's no sugar. It will always say it's a bad meal. I know it's just suggestions but if they want you to pay for this and use this for best results don't

reviews.title: Wasted my time
reviews.text: Doesn’t tell you you have to pay until after you’ve already gone through submitting all your information

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: I wish these apps would declare ight up front that there is no free version, only subscription offers. I was faked out again!

reviews.title: AI overview is so far off
reviews.text: The AI overview seemed useful but it’s so far off. How is a bowl of beans low nutrients and little protein? How is banana & strawberries and low fat plain yogurt highly processed sugar? I highly regret this annual purchase but it’s one of the only photo tracking apps … I will definitely not be renewing at the end of my year.

reviews.title: Paid app
reviews.text: Not just in-app purchases. Can’t use At all without credit card. Burn it.

reviews.title: Sad it’s paid now
reviews.text: I used this app YEARS ago and loved it. I’m on a new healthy eating journey so I wanted to redownload the app. It was cool to see they’ve added new features but I am extremely bummed to see the app is no longer free.. probably because they introduced AI, idk. ($10 a month also seems astronomical for what the app actually gives you) I don’t see that there’s an easy free version to have access to either, which I would prefer if there were just features that were locked unless you paid a subscription. Love this app, definitely still download it if you can afford it.

reviews.title: Locked behind a subscription service
reviews.text: This would help me do much if i wasnt too poor to use its monthly subscription. Feels like profit is more important than helping people here given theres no free option.
